verdict.rationale: Idempotency keys are a fair question for a payments/billing API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions idempotency keys, an Idempotency-Key header, or safe request retries. The documented dunning and Tactical Retries features retry failed customer payments, which is a different capability from client-side idempotent API request retries.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges
